thread:
Nora (AM): Kicking off Zenify POC. Requirements: SAML SSO, SCIM bulk (~475k users), SCIM group->role mappings, domain verification (multiple domains), and an on-prem air-gapped option. Need blockers + cost ranges by Mon.
Jake (SE): Quick clarification: do they need sub-hourly deltas or is 1h acceptable? Also ask if they want user provisioning only or SCIM-driven group provisioning too.
Mina (Eng): For 475k we recommend initial bulk with chunks 2k-6k, concurrency 10, and exponential backoff with jitter. Deltas hourly is typical; near-real-time requires SAML assertion mapping for enforcement or webhooks with strict backpressure.
Mina (Eng): Sample bulk curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://scim.redwood.example.com/v2/Bulk -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @bulk.json
```
Omar (Infra): Air-gapped install checklist: network diagram, host inventory, storage encryption details, approved RTO/RPO, and signed SOW. Zero control-plane access => 12-18% support uplift + one-time deployment fee.
Nora (AM): They mentioned domain proofing for multiple top-level domains and delegated DNS. Any special steps?
Jake (SE): For multi-domain we support DNS TXT proofing per domain. If they require organisation-wide claims, we can map domain claims to tenant scoping but that adds a short compliance review.
legal-bot: legal-bot: note - export controls and data residency flagged. Will need DPA addendum and export-control questionnaire answered. On-prem HSM requires chain-of-custody docs.
Mina (Eng): RBAC best-practice: use SCIM groups->roles for initial state; use SAML attributes for session-time enforcement. If they want immediate revocation, recommend short session TTLs + assertion checks.
Nora (AM): Action items: (1) Nora request network diagram, SAML metadata, and domain list; (2) Mina deliver SCIM runbook + backoff params; (3) Jake draft pricing bands: Dedicated reserved + Hosted fallback + air-gap uplift; (4) Omar produce on-prem checklist for Legal. Sync Mon EOD. :thumbsup:
